ATC — R06AX16. ATC Vet — QR06AX16. (deptropine) Pharmacopoeias. In Eur. (see p.vii). Ph. Eur. 6.2 (Deptropine Citrate). A white or almost white, mi- crocrystalline powder. Very slightly soluble in water and in dehy- drated alcohol; practically insoluble in dichloromethane. A satu- rated solution in water has a pH of 3.7 to 4.5. Protect from light. Profile Deptropine citrate is a sedating antihistamine (p.561) with a marked antimuscarinic action. It was given by mouth mainly in the treatment of respiratory-tract disorders. Дезлоратадин C19H19ClN2 = 310.8. CAS — 100643-71-8. ATC — R06AX27. ATC Vet — QR06AX27. Profile Desloratadine, the major, active metabolite of loratadine (p.583), is a non-sedating antihistamine. Desloratadine is used in the symptomatic relief of allergic conditions including rhinitis (p.565) and urticaria (p.565). Desloratadine is given in an oral dose of 5 mg once daily. It is also used with a decongestant such as pseudoephedrine sul- fate. For dosage in children, and in hepatic or renal impairment, see below. ◊ References. 1. McClellan K, Jarvis B. Desloratadine.
